notes.title: Community Group Challenge - Third goal reached? + New Challenges Status
notes.content:
Hi Dealers!

We were so close to getting 130k on Wishlist, but unfortunately we didn’t achieve it. But we’re also moved by how much support we get from you, and how much engagement you gave to grow this community. It means a lot to us, and especially, for the game!

You’re fantastic, thank you! And that’s why we’re giving you a 15% discount!

Enjoy Drug Dealer Simulator, and please - we’re counting on more of your feedback and support, it means a world to us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/5c7f6fc4980fcb718bac8b79a28dba09b4c462bf.gif

We have also an another important announcement: Two of three new goals have been already reached! :D The info about the Giveaway Stream and content of Thug Pack #1 will be revealed soon in special updates :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/762c2f5529d1ee8fe972f8b17b847f6c7c40025e.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/64c7370e84adc80e43701ebdc877996066837e81.gif

We’re really, REALLY close to the last one, so let’s make the last assault on that Steam Community Group!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/3c8ca7cc3f46bfc178c4bfa67cdd9fb82a4f6535.gif

ALSO! There’s a 15% Loyalty Discount! 
If you own at least one of the following games, you’ll get an extra 15% discount on Drug Dealer Simulator! It merges with Community Group Challenge Discount! It means a 30% discount total!!! :)

 Thief Simulator
 911 Operator
 Car Mechanic Simulator 2018
 House Flipper
 Cooking Simulator
 Tank Mechanic Simulator
 UBOAT
 The Beast Inside
 Lust for Darkness
 Plane Mechanic Simulator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/b8ac8ff0684ba9cb93649647f570a692cc661b82.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/d2482ad41c630307845abc262a9cb74148a50f13.gif

If you have problem with finding an option to join Steam Community Group or adding game to your Wishlist, check our guide:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/682990/announcements/detail/2190380454200343195

notes.title: Community Challenge - Third Goal Status + New Challenges!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/f478d4a387f32d30ccaf4bc4faa95de50cbc5039.png

Hi Dealers!

There are only two days left until the end of our challenge! We’ve reached 13,5k members of Steam Community Group! We want to thank all of you for that!! :) But we still need to remember that there’s another goal, and we’re such close to reach it! 

Do we get to 130k on Wishlist before the release of Drug Dealer Simulator? Time for mobilization!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/6107764fa89404cb666e9fe4968207deae6937d8.gif


As our challenges are going so well, we’ve decided to raise the bar! This time, the stakes are completely different!

You’ll be able not only to make a real impact on the content, but also you’ll have an opportunity to catch a full version of the Drug Dealer Simulator! We’ll inform about reaching each of these goals, the dates of their realization will be announced later in separated updates :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34426328/b06f5d3408fbda8ef2b29f9b270a076c16b27468.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/ca24887082bff55ba0ce827d74ef002bdaf449e1.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34426328/3c8ca7cc3f46bfc178c4bfa67cdd9fb82a4f6535.gif

Time to reach the new goals is unlimited!


Adding Drug Dealer Simulator to Community Group:

1. Enter Drug Dealer Simulator store page and choose “Community Hub” over the logo and game description
2. Choose “Follow” on DDS Community main window on top.
https://media.giphy.com/media/lPpxZ3hLOeRBj12V6X/giphy.gif


Adding Game to Steam Wishlist:

1. Scroll down on Drug Dealer main page until you see the "Add to your wishlist" button.
2. Hit that button! :)
https://media.giphy.com/media/ibA91l4V2AGjvWHOIR/giphy.gif

Anyone who owns at least one of the following games:

 Thief Simulator

 911 Operator

 UBOAT

 The Beast Inside

 Lust for Darkness

...Will get an extra 15% discount on the Drug Dealer Simulator! And yes, Loyalty and Community Group Challenge discounts merges in one! :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/b8ac8ff0684ba9cb93649647f570a692cc661b82.jpg

notes.title: Spread the Word - Community Challenge!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37255918/f478d4a387f32d30ccaf4bc4faa95de50cbc5039.png

So here we are, few days to the release!
We want to thank all of you for support, specially our Discord Community <3!
 
We get a lot of questions about how someone can help us, and there are a couple of things that you can do to aid us.

We encourage all of you to add Drug Dealer Simulator to steam wishlist, this will help us a ton with visibility on steam, especially on launch day! To small indie studio such ours, this is essential to help us out. This will help us expand the game in the future! Help us make this game better and bigger:)
 
Spread the word about our game:) Let more people to know about Drug Dealer Simulator! 
 
Follow our facebook fanpage: 
https://www.facebook.com/Drug-Dealer-Simulator-589299101483320/
 
Join our awesome Discord community: https://discord.gg/pMNmbVM
 
Check Drug Dealer Simulator: Free Sample if you haven’t yet: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1275630/Drug_Dealer_Simulator_Free_Sample/

 
And one more thing:)
 
To celebrate our awesome community and release of Drug Dealer Simulator we came up with little challenge for all of you :)
Below we have 3 goals that unlocks launch discount! It is up to YOU how far we get :)
